name: Calle Crisologo
description: A well-preserved Spanish colonial street lined with cobblestones and ancestral houses, popular for walking tours, calesa rides, and photography at night when the old lamps light up.

name: Bantay Bell Tower
description: An old stone watchtower and bell tower near Vigan, offering panoramic views of the surrounding rice fields and mountains, quiet and less crowded than the city center.

name: Baluarte Zoo
description: A wildlife sanctuary and mini zoo established by a former governor, home to exotic animals like tigers, camels, and various birds, popular for family day trips.

name: Pagburnayan Pottery Site
description: A traditional pottery-making site where artisans still craft clay jars using centuries-old techniques, great for cultural tours and hands-on pottery experience.

name: Vigan Public Plaza
description: A historic town square surrounded by heritage buildings and the Vigan Cathedral, a peaceful spot for an evening stroll and people-watching.

name: Mindoro Beach
description: A quiet, less commercialized beach with calm waters and fine sand, ideal for a relaxing peaceful getaway away from crowded tourist beaches.

name: Pinsal Falls
description: A scenic multi-tiered waterfall surrounded by lush greenery, popular for swimming, cliff diving, and picnics, requires a short trek to reach.

name: Manalo Falls
description: A hidden waterfall accessible via a short hike, known for its cool clear water and peaceful surroundings, a favorite among adventure and nature seekers.

name: Salomague Port View
description: A scenic coastal viewpoint near the port area with dramatic cliffs and ocean views, a good spot for sunset watching and photography.

name: Sabang Beach
description: A long stretch of beach popular with locals for swimming and weekend gatherings, with nearby food stalls selling grilled seafood.

name: Magsingal Museum
description: A local heritage museum showcasing artifacts, old photographs, and relics from the town's history, ideal for a short educational visit.

name: Chavit Singson Ancestral House
description: A grand ancestral house showcasing colonial architecture and family heirlooms, offering a glimpse into the lifestyle of old Ilocano elite families.

name: Bantay Church and Tower
description: A centuries old church paired with its iconic watchtower, one of the most photographed heritage landmarks in the province.

name: Kapurpurawan Rock Formation
description: Not in Vigan but a famous white rock formation on the coast known for dramatic wind-and-wave-carved shapes, popular for scenic photography.

name: Lingsat Public Market Food Row
description: A bustling local market area known for authentic Ilocano street food like empanada, okoy, and bagnet, best visited in the late afternoon.

name: Café Leona
description: A cozy heritage-style cafe inside Calle Crisologo serving Ilocano dishes and coffee, popular for its ambient old-world interior.

name: Grandpa's Inn Restaurant
description: A well-known local restaurant serving traditional Ilocano cuisine such as pinakbet and bagnet, a favorite stop for tourists after heritage tours.

name: Cafe Uno Vigan
description: A casual dining spot known for local and Filipino comfort food, popular with both tourists and locals for lunch and merienda.

name: Bantay Camarin Bagnet House
description: A local eatery specializing in crispy bagnet and other Ilocano delicacies, a go-to spot for authentic regional flavors.

name: Mestizo Restaurant
description: An upscale restaurant near Calle Crisologo offering Ilocano and Filipino fusion dishes in a heritage-inspired setting.
